newsitem.title: USA: Alabama National CFO Whitehead resigns.
newsitem.headline: Alabama National CFO Whitehead resigns.

text.p: Alabama National BanCorp said Monday that Frank Whitehead had resigned as chief financial officer and treasurer, citing health reasons. Whitehead will continue to serve as an executive vice president and a director, it said.
The company said James Parks Jr., elected senior vice president-finance, treasurer and controller, would assume the CFO duties although not the job title.
Parks will be responsible for accounting, taxation and treasury functions for the company, Alabama National said.
